> **SETTLED — do not re-raise:** members are the investors and the only people paid out. "Ownership, not profit-share" is rejected. Legal/securities questions about this go to `socialus-legal` for counsel and never come back to the PM as a decision. SocialUs takes transaction income; any 'no fee' language is retired.

### Meta-layer trial (tuning the scores)

Why: "stick with this and keep improving it" (trial started 2026-10-10). Tracker: https://github.com/donlafranchi/socialus-ops/issues/89

**Trial health: on schedule.** 2 of 2 built scores read within the last 8 days: score-ci-health (2026-10-10); score-doc-drift (2026-10-10).

Meta PRs: 1 proposed, 1 approved and merged, 0 rejected, 0 open.

Scores that moved: none yet (needs two readings).

Not built yet: `score-gap-leakage`, `score-review-coverage`, `score-rework`, `score-pm-overrule`. Next: `score-gap-leakage`, waiting on a few weeks of `build-log/reports/` feature reports (first batch lands 2026-10-10).

Tuning notes (2026-10-10):
- **Is each score measuring what it should? (false reds and misses, with examples)** `ci_fail_pct` 27.9% red: **likely a false red.** It mixes two things. Branch and PR runs: 55 failed of 173 (32%), which is CI doing its job during a fix loop. Runs on `main`: 13 failed of 71 (18%), which is the real concern. [V, `gh run list -w CI`, 14 days from 2026-10-10] `smoke_red_pct` 66.7% red: **real.** 2 of 3 scheduled runs failed; the visible error is `ERR_ABORTED` on a Page route (issue #552). Only 3 schedu
- **What to adjust (threshold, source, formula)** Split `ci_fail_pct` into `ci_main_fail_pct` (green ≤5, amber ≤15, assumed) and `ci_pr_first_run_fail_pct` (reported, no band for now). Count smoke over 14 days only when there are at least 7 scheduled runs; otherwise show the count and no band. Split `scenario-status` into "all Issues closed and a feature report shows unbuilt criteria" (real) versus the rest (informational), once reports exist. Add handoff and ROADMA
- **Which score to build next** `score-gap-leakage`: the feature reports (first batch 2026-10-10) will show which of the 9 approved-but-closed scenarios are real leakage, which also settles the `scenario-status` false-red question above.

Tuning review: 2026-10-24 (13 days). Each Friday: false reds and misses with examples, what to adjust, which score next.
